shows.title: Sister Act
shows.description:
Sister Act is the feel-good musical comedy smash based on the hit 1992 film that has audiences jumping to their feet! Featuring original music by Tony- and eight-time Oscar winner, Alan Menken (Newsies, Beauty and the Beast, Little Shop of Horrors), this uplifting musical was nominated for five Tony Awards, including Best Musical.

When disco diva, Deloris Van Cartier, witnesses a murder, she is put in protective custody in the one place the cops are sure she won't be a found: a convent! Disguised as a nun, she finds herself at odds with both the rigid lifestyle and uptight Mother Superior. Using her unique disco moves and singing talent to inspire the choir, Deloris breathes new life into the church and community but, in doing so, blows her cover. Soon, the gang is giving chase, only to find them up against Deloris and the power of her newly found sisterhood.

Filled with powerful gospel music, outrageous dancing and a truly moving story, Sister Act will leave audiences breathless. The cast is chock full of amazing roles for women of all ages, making this a perfect choice for high schools and community theatres. A sparkling tribute to the universal power of friendship, Sister Act is reason to REJOICE!
shows.shortDescription: A woman hiding in a convent helps her fellow sisters find their voices as she rediscovers her own. This feel-good comedy smash is based on the hit film.

shows.title: Beetlejuice Jr.
shows.description:
It's our show now, kid. The ghost-with-the-most comes to the stage in Beetlejuice JR., the frightfully funny musical based on the beloved motion picture turned Broadway phenomenon. Lydia Deetz is a strange and unusual teenager, still grieving the loss of her mother and obsessed with the whole “being dead thing.” Lucky for Lydia, she and her father move to a new house haunted by a recently deceased couple and Beetlejuice, a delightful demon with a real zest for life. When Lydia calls on Beetlejuice to scare away anyone with a pulse, this double-crossing specter shows his true stripes, unleashing a (Nether)world of pandemonium.

With music and lyrics by Tony Award-nominee Eddie Perfect and a book by Tony Award-nominated pair Anthony King and Scott Brown, Beetlejuice was nominated for eight 2019 Tony Awards including Best New Musical. A viral "sucks-yes" on social media, this musical struck a chord with young theatre lovers who adored its unabashed humor and emotional honesty.
shows.shortDescription: Lydia Deetz, a grieving teenager, teams up with a mischievous demon, Beetlejuice, to haunt her new home and scare away her father and his fiancée.

siteSettings.value: Welcome to the Reading Civic Theatre's home!

We’re thrilled to have you join our vibrant community dedicated to the performing arts.

 Our theater is a hub of creativity and camaraderie, where individuals of all ages and backgrounds come together to create unforgettable theatrical experiences. 

Thank you for supporting your local arts community, and we look forward to seeing you at the theater!

Reading Civic Theatre is proud to be a 501(c)(3) non-profit organization dedicated to bringing quality Broadway-style musicals to the Reading area.

The reality of community theatre is that ticket sales alone cannot cover the costs of our productions, let alone our operational expenses. We rely on the generosity of our community—businesses, patrons, and friends like you—to bridge that gap.

Your tax-deductible donation helps us fund:
• Professional-grade sets, costumes, and orchestras
• Venue rentals and technical resources
• Opportunities for local talent to shine

Every contribution, no matter the size, plays a vital role in keeping our tradition alive. Thank you for supporting the arts in Berks County!

pages.title: Membership
pages.content:
Membership in Reading Civic Theatre for the current year (2026) is free, with extra paid options with generous benefits based on the tier you select! We also have several categories of membership, ranging from Adult to Student to Family memberships where three or more members of one family can join. 

Members receive our newsletter, "The Vocalines", which contains important information about our current and upcoming shows, auditions and meetings. Each issue arrives approximately around the middle of each month, towards the end of the second week to the beginning of the third week.

Membership also affords you the opportunity to vote in our board elections and other society issues (Note: Student members do not have a vote in elections and other matters.) 

That being said, you do not have to be a member to attend any of our meetings! We would love to see any of you there to find out what we're all about and what we stand for. 

The general membership meetings are held on the third Monday of the following months on these following dates: 

- February 16, 2026
- May 18, 2026
- August 17, 2026
- December 21, 2026

These meetings will be held at our current theatre (The old Fox Theatre complex in Exeter) located at: 

4350 Perkiomen Ave
Reading, PA 19606
